package.description: Windows folder stealth tool with whitelist-based access control

en-US.description: Windows folder stealth tool with whitelist-based access control
en-US.longDescription: StasherX is a Windows folder stealth tool that hides selected directories without moving or encrypting them. It uses low-level filesystem protection and whitelist-based access control so only approved applications can see your hidden folders. Free for Personal and Small Business use on up to 5 computers. Business and Enterprise use requires contacting Next IT Computers.
en-US.name: StasherX
